<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cabin+Sketch:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
  /* Page-specific background for index only */
  body {
    background-image: url('images/home/mosaic.png');
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-attachment: fixed;
    min-height: 100vh;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* Responsive background adjustments */
  @media screen and (max-width: 768px) {
    body {
      background-attachment: scroll;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center top;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (max-width: 480px) {
    body {
      background-attachment: scroll;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center center;
      min-height: 100vh;
    }
  }

  /* Landscape orientation on mobile */
  @media screen and (max-width: 768px) and (orientation: landscape) {
    body {
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center center;
      min-height: 100vh;
    }
  }

  .animated-text {
    font-size: 80px;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Cabin Sketch';
    text-align: center;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }

  /* ========== ANIMATIONS ========== */
  @keyframes skillsMove {
    from {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
    to {
      transform: translateX(-100%);
    }
  }

  @keyframes serviceMove {
    from {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
    to {
      transform: translateX(-100%);
    }
  }

  /* ========== SKILLS SECTION ========== */
  .skills-carousel {
    position: relative;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .header-skills {
    position: absolute;
    top: -3%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    min-width: 6em;
    padding: 0.1em 0.4em;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Cabin Sketch';
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 25px;
    background: rgba(225, 215, 215, 0.8);
    border-radius: 25px;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  .skills {
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 20px 10px 0px 10px;
    background: rgba(225, 215, 215, 0.6);
    white-space: nowrap;
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 25px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .skills:before,
  .skills:after {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    width: 250px;
    height: 100%;
    content: "";
    z-index: 2;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .skills:before {
    left: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
  }

  .skills:after {
    right: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(to left, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
  }

  .skills:hover .skills-slide {
    animation-play-state: paused !important;
  }

  .skills-slide {
    display: inline-block;
    animation: 70s skillsMove infinite linear;
  }

  .skills-slide img {
    height: 80px;
    margin: 0 40px;
    padding: 10px 0px 0px 0px;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  }

  .skills-slide img:hover {
    transform: scale(1.2);
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  /* ========== SERVICES SECTION ========== */
  .services-carousel {
    position: relative;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .header-services {
    position: absolute;
    top: -3%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    min-width: 6em;
    padding: 0.1em 0.4em;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Cabin Sketch';
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 25px;
    background: rgba(225, 215, 215, 0.8);
    border-radius: 25px;
    z-index: 4;
  }

  .bottom-about-services {
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    min-width: 6em;
    padding: 0.1em 0.4em;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'Cabin Sketch';
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 25px;
    background: rgba(225, 215, 215, 0.8);
    border-radius: 25px;
    z-index: 4;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #333;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .bottom-about-services:hover {
    background: rgba(225, 215, 215, 0.9);
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.15);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    color: #000;
  }

  .services {
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 20px 10px 0px 0px;
    background: rgba(225, 215, 215, 0.6);
    white-space: nowrap;
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 45px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    margin: 15px auto;
    width: 75%;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .services:before,
  .services:after {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    width: 250px;
    height: 100%;
    content: "";
    z-index: 2;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .services:before {
    left: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
  }

  .services:after {
    right: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(to left, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
  }

  .services:hover .services-slide {
    animation-play-state: paused !important;
  }

  .services-slide {
    display: inline-block;
    vertical-align: middle;
    animation: 50s serviceMove infinite linear;
  }

  .services-slide img {
    height: 80px;
    margin: 0 40px;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  }

  .services-slide img:hover {
    transform: scale(1.2);
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .service-item {
    display: inline-block;
    text-align: center;
    margin: 0 20px;
    vertical-align: top;
  }

  .service-item span {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-family: 'Cabin Sketch';
    font-size: 20px;
    color: #333;
    font-weight: bold;
  }

  /* ========== RESPONSIVE DESIGN ========== */
  /* Mobile devices (up to 768px) */
  @media screen and (max-width: 768px) {
    .animated-text {
      font-size: 40px;
    }
    
    .header-skills,
    .header-services {
      font-size: 18px;
      padding: 0.1em 0.3em;
      min-width: 4em;
    }
    
    .skills {
      width: 95%;
      padding: 15px 5px 0px 5px;
    }
    
    .services {
      width: 95%;
      padding: 15px 5px 0px 0px;
    }
    
    .skills-slide img,
    .services-slide img {
      height: 50px;
      margin: 0 20px;
    }
    
    .skills:before,
    .skills:after,
    .services:before,
    .services:after {
      width: 100px;
    }
    
    .service-item {
      margin: 0 15px;
    }
    
    .service-item span {
      font-size: 14px;
      margin-top: 5px;
    }
    
    .skills-slide {
      animation: 40s skillsMove infinite linear;
    }
    
    .services-slide {
      animation: 35s serviceMove infinite linear;
    }
    
    .bottom-about-services {
      font-size: 14px;
      padding: 0.1em 0.3em;
      min-width: 5em;
    }
  }
  
  /* Tablet devices (769px to 1024px) */
  @media screen and (min-width: 769px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
    .animated-text {
      font-size: 60px;
    }
    
    .header-skills,
    .header-services {
      font-size: 22px;
    }
    
    .skills {
      width: 97%;
    }
    
    .services {
      width: 90%;
    }
    
    .skills-slide img,
    .services-slide img {
      height: 65px;
      margin: 0 30px;
    }
    
    .skills:before,
    .skills:after,
    .services:before,
    .services:after {
      width: 180px;
    }
    
    .service-item span {
      font-size: 18px;
    }
    
    .skills-slide {
      animation: 50s skillsMove infinite linear;
    }
    
    .services-slide {
      animation: 42s serviceMove infinite linear;
    }
    
    .bottom-about-services {
      font-size: 18px;
    }
  }
  
  /* Large screens (1025px and up) */
  @media screen and (min-width: 1025px) {
    .animated-text {
      font-size: 80px;
    }
    
    .skills-slide img,
    .services-slide img {
      height: 80px;
      margin: 0 40px;
    }
    
    .skills-slide {
      animation: 60s skillsMove infinite linear;
    }
    
    .services-slide {
      animation: 50s serviceMove infinite linear;
    }
  }
  
  /* Extra small devices (up to 480px) */
  @media screen and (max-width: 625px) {
    .animated-text {
      font-size: 28px;
      padding: 0 10px;
    }
    
    .header-skills,
    .header-services {
      font-size: 16px;
      padding: 0.1em 0.2em;
      min-width: 3em;
    }
    
    .skills,
    .services {
      width: 98%;
      padding: 10px 2px 0px 2px;
      border-radius: 15px;
    }
    
    .skills-slide img,
    .services-slide img {
      height: 40px;
      margin: 0 15px;
    }
    
    .skills:before,
    .skills:after,
    .services:before,
    .services:after {
      width: 80px;
    }
    
    .service-item {
      margin: 0 10px;
    }
    
    .service-item span {
      font-size: 12px;
      margin-top: 3px;
    }
    
    .skills-slide {
      animation: 30s skillsMove infinite linear;
    }
    
    .services-slide {
      animation: 25s serviceMove infinite linear;
    }
    
    .bottom-about-services {
      font-size: 14px;
      padding: 0.1em 0.2em;
      min-width: 22em;
    }
  }

</style>
